about: Every route the privacy ledger can record, mapped to a consent record under the Israeli Privacy Protection Authority's consent guidance of 25 Feb 2026 (research R3.10): active opt-in, no pre-ticked box, named recipients, withdrawal in one click, re-consent when the purpose changes. Plan W11.S11. Checked by src/__tests__/privacyDoc.test.ts. Not legal advice: part of the legal review packet (W6.37).

guidance.summary: secondary source (a law firm's summary), not the guidance's own text

records.purpose: Answer the AI request the user made, with the user's own key
records.dataSent: The prompt and the text the user chose to send

ppa2026.activeOptIn: The user enters their own API key, picks the provider, and picks the policy local-first or cloud (default: local-only).
ppa2026.withdrawal: Settings → Privacy → "Local only": one switch blocks every route in the cloud-ai, cloud-text, research, third-party, monitoring and plugin categories at once (the ledger's local-only policy), except a single request the user explicitly agrees to at that moment, which the ledger records as consented (Wikidata is refused even then). Also: remove the key in Settings → AI.
ppa2026.reconsentOnChange: A route's purpose or recipient changes only with a release that changes its ledger rule; docs/legal/consent-records.md (Re-consent) says what that release must do.
